global_availability: DermGPT is available to dermatologists for free at www.dermgpt.com [SOURCE 3]
summary: DermGPT is an AI chatbot developed by Dr. Faranak Kamangar to streamline clinical tasks, improve access to dermatologic data, and save time for physicians by providing specific and reliable information from peer-reviewed articles. [SOURCE 3, SOURCE 4]
keywords: AI; dermatology; chatbot; clinical efficiency; psoriasis; eczema; prior authorization; patient education
intended_use_and_workflow: DermGPT assists dermatologists and their staff by providing quick access to information, answering clinical queries, looking up data, and accessing patient handouts. It can be used to look up diagnoses, treatments, and prior authorization criteria, as well as for patient management and shared decision-making. [SOURCE 3]
primary_intended_users: The primary intended users are dermatologists, RNs, MAs, and ancillary staff. [SOURCE 3]
necessary_knowledge_expertise: Users need a basic understanding of dermatology and clinical practice. It is designed to be user-friendly with clear navigation and easy-to-understand instructions. [SOURCE 3]
how_to_use: Dermatologists can ask questions in natural language and receive relevant answers. DermGPT can be used to look up information, answer patient questions, and access handouts. [SOURCE 3]
targeted_patient_population: DermGPT is intended for use in dermatological practices, benefiting patients requiring specialty medications and those seeking access to cutting-edge treatments. It is intended to improve patient care and access to dermatology information. [SOURCE 3]
patient_consent_or_disclosure_required_o: DermGPT can provide informed consent language regarding procedures and telehealth consults [SOURCE 4].
developer_supplied_warnings: DermGPT does not replace medical care or decision-making and should not be used as a stand-alone decision maker, but as an assistant. [SOURCE 3]
model_limitations: DermGPT should not be used as a stand-alone decision maker but as an assistant. [SOURCE 4]
ai_system_facts: DermGPT is an AI chatbot built on more than 3,000 peer-reviewed articles designed to improve clinical efficiency and assist with common tasks in a dermatological practice setting.
interaction_with_other_systems: DermGPT can integrate with existing EHR systems to streamline documentation and facilitate seamless information exchange. [SOURCE 4]
outcomes_and_output: DermGPT can provide quick references for medication options, summarize diagnosis and treatment guidelines, suggest appropriate labs and procedures, automate documentation, write insurance authorization letters, create patient handouts, summarize medical notes, assist with study guides, and provide informed consent language. [SOURCE 4]
type_and_value_of_solution_output: DermGPT offers information on diagnoses, treatments, and prior authorization criteria. It also provides patient management and shared decision-making tools such as patient educational handouts and prescription programs. [SOURCE 4]
explanation_for_how_an_output_is_generat: DermGPT pulls information from a proprietary database of trusted, physician-approved sources and peer-reviewed medical journals. [SOURCE 4]
foundation_models_used_in_application_if: DermGPT is built on a large language model with a proprietary database of over 3,000 peer-reviewed articles [SOURCE 3, 4].
relevance_of_training_data_to_intended_p: The training data is highly relevant as it consists of over 3,000 peer-reviewed dermatology articles [SOURCE 3].
bias_mitigation_approaches: DermGPT uses a specific dataset to avoid errors and hallucinations that general language models might produce [SOURCE 3].
ongoing_maintenance: DermGPT is continuously updated and improved [SOURCE 4].
transparency_information: DermGPT is built on more than 3,000 peer-reviewed articles, providing reliable and specific answers [SOURCE 3]. It pulls from trusted, physician-approved sources [SOURCE 4].
usefulness_efficacy_goal_of_metrics: To improve patient care and streamline dermatology practices by assisting with increasing clinical tasks and making dermatology information readily available. [SOURCE 4]
usefulness_efficacy_result: DermGPT saves dermatologists time and improves access to dermatologic data [SOURCE 4].
usefulness_efficacy_interpretation: DermGPT can save dermatologists time, leading to more efficient patient care, decreased wait times, and less physician burnout. [SOURCE 4]
usefulness_efficacy_testing_data_descrip: DermGPT is built on more than 3,000 peer-reviewed articles to provide specific and reliable answers. [SOURCE 3]
